question: Does selected Light F2 plus exact provisional D3 Dark preserve the accepted Production Shaping / Current Possibility architecture under a denser decision-and-inspection workspace without semantic or visual regression?

fixed_visual_inputs.typography: TYP-02 F1 Ratio Ladder / system-ui carrier

fixed_semantics: Current possibility remains a creator working frame, not a predictive recommendation surface.
Contextual inspector remains subordinate to current situation.
Selection remains inspection state only; keyboard focus remains independent.
Current/historical and provisional/effective distinctions remain non-color-dependent.
No Product-gated controls or Stage successor are introduced.
falsification: D3 fails if the denser Shaping workspace becomes muddy or visually flatter than selected Light F2.
D3 fails if violet/aubergine structure becomes more salient than current situation, selected meaning or contextual inspection hierarchy.
D3 fails if teal spreads beyond scarce structural state reinforcement or begins to imply product/status meaning.
Integration fails if MAT F1 becomes decorative segmentation or changes functional grouping.
Integration fails if TYP F1 harms scanability or 200% text/text-spacing behavior.
Integration fails if selected meaning and keyboard focus become visually conflated.
Any Product-semantic invention or Shaping IA change invalidates the study.
execution_law: Use exact frozen F2 and D3 role values; no color retune after first complete render.
Derive from the accepted functional carrier rather than reconstructing its hierarchy from memory.
Mechanical corrections may restore responsive/accessibility behavior but may not alter the frozen color roles or semantic architecture.
D3 remains provisional even after a local PASS; continued representative-section evaluation is required before final dark-token freeze.
next_gate: Materialize the exact Shaping carrier with MAT F1 + TYP F1 + STA F2 and selected Light F2 / provisional D3 Dark, then run the full seven-condition matrix and recursive visual-semantic audit.
